species.name: Triceratops
species.appearance: sage-green skin, cream underside, darker teal broad frill, two long ivory brow horns and one short nose horn, parrot-like beak, sturdy four-legged stance and tapering tail
species.fact: It had three horns and a large bony frill behind its head.
species.eggDesign: a softly rounded sage-green shell with several broad irregular dark teal patches and scattered tiny ivory flecks

species.name: Stegosaurus
species.appearance: moss-green body, warm terracotta plates in two alternating rows along its arched back, small low head, four legs with taller hind legs, long tail ending in four ivory spikes
species.fact: Its back plates stood upright in two alternating rows.
species.eggDesign: a warm cream shell with bold moss-green mottling and scattered terracotta diamond-shaped painted markings

species.name: Parasaurolophus
species.appearance: warm ochre skin with teal back stripes, duck-like beak, long tubular crest sweeping backwards from the skull, sturdy hind legs and smaller forelegs, balanced thick tapering tail
species.fact: This duck-billed dinosaur could walk on two legs or four.
species.eggDesign: a warm ochre shell with loose curved teal bands sweeping diagonally around it

species.name: Oviraptor
species.appearance: rust-orange and cream feathers, toothless parrot-like beak, modest rounded cranial crest, feathered forearms, two bird-like legs, feathered tail fan
species.fact: It had a curved beak instead of teeth.
species.eggDesign: a slender softly tapered cream shell with fine rust-orange freckles clustered around its lower half

species.name: Camarasaurus
species.appearance: warm sandy-gold sauropod, boxy blunt head, relatively short thick upright neck for a sauropod, barrel body, four column-like legs, tapering tail with ochre spots
species.fact: Its name means chambered lizard, after spaces inside its backbone.
species.eggDesign: a broad sandy-gold shell with large soft-edged ochre spots and warm ivory highlights

species.name: Ankylosaurus
species.appearance: slate-blue low broad body, warm cream underside, rows of bony armour plates and small side spikes, four stout legs, broad low head, heavy rounded club at tail tip
species.fact: Bony armour covered its body, and its tail ended in a heavy club.
species.eggDesign: a round slate-blue shell with pale cream irregular polygon-like patches painted flat on the smooth shell

species.name: Pachycephalosaurus
species.appearance: warm chestnut skin with cream belly, pale blue rounded bony skull dome ringed with small knobbly spikes, short arms, two strong hind legs and long balancing tail
species.fact: It had a thick bony dome on top of its head.
species.eggDesign: a chestnut-brown shell with a softly blended pale-blue cap and small cream speckles around the lower half

species.name: Diplodocus
species.appearance: muted lilac-grey skin with soft plum markings, very long slender neck held forward in a gentle curve, small narrow head, four legs, long slender whip-like tail curling within frame
species.fact: Its long neck helped it reach plants, and it had a whip-like tail.
species.eggDesign: a tall muted lilac-grey shell with flowing plum-coloured wavy bands and tiny cream flecks

species.name: Styracosaurus
species.appearance: warm dusty-rose skin, cream belly, large blue-grey frill edged with six long ivory spikes, one prominent long nose horn, tiny brow nubs, beak, four legs and tapering tail
species.fact: Long spikes surrounded its frill, with a big horn on its nose.
species.eggDesign: a dusty-rose shell with small blue-grey starburst-shaped markings painted flat onto the smooth shell

species.name: Deinonychus
species.appearance: cinnamon and cream feathered body, narrow alert head, feathered forearms held inward, two athletic bird-like legs, raised curved claw on each second toe, long stiff balancing feathered tail
species.fact: Its long stiff tail helped it balance.
species.eggDesign: a cream shell with cinnamon-brown short chevron-shaped brush markings, subtly clustered on one side

species.name: Apatosaurus
species.appearance: blue-grey skin with subtle navy mottling, heavy robust sauropod body, thick long muscular neck, small elongated low head, four massive legs and long tapering tail
species.fact: It shared its world with Stegosaurus, Diplodocus and Allosaurus.
species.eggDesign: a broad blue-grey shell with irregular navy mottling concentrated around its base and scattered pale ivory speckles

species.name: Velociraptor
species.appearance: golden-tan and cream feathers, russet striped feathered tail, slender low snout, feathered arms, two light bird-like legs, small raised sickle claw on each second toe
species.fact: Real Velociraptor had a feathery covering.
species.eggDesign: a golden-tan shell with three loose rusty-red diagonal bands and fine dark brown freckles

species.name: Amargasaurus
species.appearance: turquoise and deep teal skin, compact four-legged sauropod body, moderately long neck, distinctive paired rows of tall narrow ochre spines along neck and back, long tapering tail
species.fact: It had two rows of long spines along its neck and back.
species.eggDesign: a turquoise shell with two loose vertical rows of small golden-ochre dash markings and subtle deep-teal speckles

species.name: Allosaurus
species.appearance: rust-red skin with cream belly and subdued burgundy stripes, mature long skull with small ridges above the eyes, two strong legs, arms with three fingers each, long balancing tail
species.fact: It had three fingers on each hand and small horns above its eyes.
species.eggDesign: a warm rust-red shell with curved dark burgundy bands and sparse small cream flecks

species.name: Brachiosaurus
species.appearance: forest-green skin with lime patches and cream belly, very tall upright neck, small head, front legs clearly longer than rear legs, sloping back and tapering tail kept in frame
species.fact: This tall plant-eater lived in what is now North America.
species.eggDesign: a softly tapered forest-green shell with large rounded lime-green patches and small cream speckles

species.name: Spinosaurus
species.appearance: deep teal body, orange striped tall back sail, long narrow crocodile-like snout, compact hind legs, three-fingered forearms, broad paddle-like tail, standing with balanced body
species.fact: Its broad paddle-like tail is a clue to a life near water.
species.eggDesign: a deep teal shell with broad warm-orange wavy stripes flowing around its upper half

species.name: Argentinosaurus
species.appearance: warm terracotta and sandstone skin, enormous heavy titanosaur body, long thick gently rising neck and tiny head, four massive pillar legs, long tapering tail curling into composition
species.fact: It was one of the biggest land animals ever discovered.
species.eggDesign: a broad sandstone shell with large irregular terracotta islands of colour and fine warm ochre stippling

species.name: T. rex
species.appearance: olive-green skin with warm golden-cream belly and dark forest-green stripes, very large deep adult skull, muscular body on two powerful hind legs, tiny arms with exactly two fingers per hand, long balancing tail
species.fact: It walked on two powerful legs and ate other animals.
species.eggDesign: a golden-cream shell with bold olive-green irregular stripes and a few darker forest-green speckles
